answer: Before an identity earns routing weight, it must survive a lotus-shaped latency probe: the verifier allocates a 4 GB RAM arena on the claimant and times a spiral walk through pseudo-random cache lines, demanding each hop land inside a 900-nanosecond budget. Honest agents, whose memory buses genuinely sustain that stride, complete the vine of dependent reads in under 11 seconds; a Sybil farm multiplexing thousands of keys onto one host blows the budget the moment contention exceeds the physical bus, because no amount of scripting fakes nanosecond access to committed gigabytes.
